summary_en: This phase II study tests neoadjuvant enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab, followed by assessments that guide later treatment, in people with muscle-invasive bladder cancer (clinical stage T2-T3, N0, M0). Enfortumab vedotin is given into a vein at 1.25 mg/kg (maximum 125 mg) on Days 1 and 8 of each 21-day cycle for 3 cycles, and pembrolizumab is given into a vein at 200 mg on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle, or as a subcutaneous form per protocol. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is a phase II trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa enfortumab vedotina más pembrolizumab administrados antes de la cirugía (neoadyuvancia), seguidos de evaluaciones que orientan los tratamientos posteriores, en personas con cáncer de vejiga que invade el músculo (estadio clínico T2-T3, N0, M0). La enfortumab vedotina se administra por vena a 1,25 mg/kg (máximo 125 mg) los días 1 y 8 de cada ciclo de 21 días, durante 3 ciclos, y el pembrolizumab se administra por vena a 200 mg el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, o en su forma subcutánea según el protocolo. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Bladder urothelial carcinoma confirmed by pathology report, including mixed variant histology
Muscle invasion shown on tissue examination
Clinical stage T2-T3, N0, M0 disease
not_for: Small cell histology in any part of the tumor
Prior systemic chemotherapy for muscle-invasive bladder cancer
Prior PD-1, PD-L1 or CD137 agonist therapy
Uncontrolled diabetes, HbA1c above 8.5%, or a history of listed autoimmune disease
